name: VO2 3x6 threshold moderate 47
description: Three 6 min reps at 10.0 km/h level 1, just below VO2max pace, 3 min jogs: supports VO2 work with sustained hard running. Needs --running-mode, handrail up. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, building gently. Last minutes just under the first rep pace.

steps.name: Recover
steps.notes: Easy jog or walk; let the breathing drop.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Jog then walk until the breathing is calm.
